objective: Verify actual valid timestamp/lat/lon event-day coverage and per-day distinct tag presence from exactly one source-size-pinned original CC0 GPS ZIP per experimental cohort. Determine whether source groups can overlap in actual observation dates, not whether birds were co-located.
source: Bontekoe et al (2023) Proceedings B DOI 10.1098/rspb.2023.1268; original archived CC0 Movebank Data Repository GPS files.
zip_selection: For each cohort, source's ORIGINAL bundle .zip containing gps/location with smallest original size. Same three frozen 4KiB/65KiB/CSV-header verified members in PR420. Do not change archive based on data outcomes.
data_scope: Download the full single selected CC0 GPS ZIP per cohort to a private ephemeral GitHub Actions runner; verify declared DSpace original full ZIP MD5, byte count and built-in zip member CRC. Never upload/commit/archive the original content. Other 5 GPS ZIPs and all accelerometer ZIPs remain uninspected; findings are NOT full-study coverage.
time_rule: Parse timestamp as ISO8601 with timezone, accept explicit Z and ±offset; if no offset, treat naive string as UTC only because original Movebank event timestamp specification is UTC, and declare it. Reject nonparseable; do not infer from other columns.
spatial_quality: A valid georeferenced event requires parseable UTC date, numeric finite latitude between -90 and 90 and longitude between -180 and 180, and nonempty tag-local-identifier. This is source data-support validity only, not GPS movement accuracy or biological location fidelity.
sampling: Read EVERY CSV event row in exactly the selected main ZIP member (largest .csv of the expected 1 or 2 member ZIP). Do not cherry-pick days, tags or outcomes. The other 176-byte member in control and delayed is NOT treated as GPS events.
output_only_aggregate: complete original selected ZIP MD5 compared with source metadata, ZIP CRC verified
raw main-member CSV row count and counts missing timestamp/tag/lat/lon, coordinate-range invalid, invalid timestamp; do not report original values
yearly GPS valid events, distinct observed tag count, distinct observed animal-id count and distinct observation-date count
annual distinct dates with >=2 distinct observed tags
one daily aggregate array: date, n valid coordinate events, n observed distinct tags only (no tag names, GPS positions, raw timestamps, individual trajectories or within-day hours)
source full coverage classification. Original source excludes the other 5 GPS ZIPs, so no whole-population claims.
date_join_future: A later derived-only analysis may join cohort daily aggregates by exact UTC date to measure 2/3-group same-date coverage; this is NOT individual same-time geospatial co-occurrence. Save original source output separately per group.
safety_and_claim_limits: Original animal GPS rows remain ephemeral and never committed/uploaded as artifact
Annual or daily aggregated tag-counts have no information about exact spatial co-presence or cue reception
No reuse of a tag string as cross-cohort same-individual join; source shows tag reuse and missing deployment IDs
No ecological q, r or q×r model, no survival or movement effect fitting, and no results from Bontekoe 2023 relabeled novel
Any absent dates in the one selected ZIP do not mean no cohort tracking; other GPS ZIPs not scanned
GPS timestamp date-only UTC cannot establish exact simultaneous proximity or same geographical opportunity
